tokens.v: Stand it back at the room's far third, small against the plaster, the shadow launching off its feet to run the full diagonal of the terrazzo before it climbs and folds up the far wall. 50mm at f/8, camera 40cm off the floor and square to the shadow's run. Hang fine dust in the skylight's shaft so the beam edge reads in the air, the far corner sinking to near-black while each oak shelf edge takes one specular line. A chalk-plaster wall return stands dark in the immediate foreground, its arris cutting the left edge and the bottom corner.
